content_html: Once I was using a third party application (I won’t say what it was for legal reasons!) and we had a number of support calls out to them to fix bugs. I knew it was written in .Net. We waited and waited and got tired of waiting. So I ran reflector over it, pulled the code out into a separate project… fixed the bugs and recompiled it. It worked. I never told them I did that. Did I do something bad? Probably. Do I want people doing that to my code? Absolutely not. So I’ll probably obfuscate my code to stop people like me snooping.
